read: GET /api/engine/deals and GET /api/engine/deals/{deal_id} return seen and the current phase_change. Undo uses receipts with automatic=true and source=copied or source=call_capture. evidence_date is the Central calendar day the move took effect. Copied receipts have call=null. Call capture receipts include call.activity_id and call.happened_at. Partner-accepted call suggestions have no automatic receipt.
write: POST /api/engine/deals/{deal_id}/phase/undo with idempotency_key, event_id, and base_version from seen.
result: Success returns deal_id, phase, and phase_changed_at. A stale deal or event returns version_conflict. A return to an ended phase adds the Closed deals or Lost deals hint to that refusal.
